shaderScalarMath: Custom LitInput.hlsl surface initialization and channel sampling are unchanged from installed URP17.6.0. Additional code adds wind parameters/function. Forward pass differs by wind call, backface normal flip and albedo-tinted transmission.
newHypothesis: Very pale RGB in the low-alpha source fringe can contaminate small leaf mips/MSAA edge pixels. A color-dilated candidate retaining the exact alpha is a useful isolated audition. Actual Unity imported mips and matched native captures must establish the effect; alphaIsTransparency is already enabled and may mitigate it.
otherConfirmedShaderLimitations: Transmission uses GetMainLight(shadowCoord) rather than the distance-faded position overload.
Transmission samples TransformWorldToShadowCoord even under a screen-space shadow variant, which would require screen coordinates.
Transmission term bypasses AO and main-light distance/culling attenuation.
notEstablished: No proof that transmission alone causes the silver appearance.
No proof that normal orientation/import is wrong.
No proof that pale alpha fringes are the dominant runtime contributor.
No AAA or final visual acceptance.
